patterns.message: Import Pi Durable, pi-ai, pi-schema, and chord through src/agent/pi/ (durable.ts, shared.ts, …) so an upgrade is fixed in one folder.

Only the Telegram door reads or writes its documents (COD-210). Core reaches its inputs and chats through the door's registrations (src/doors/telegram/index.ts); the composition root may name the door's runtime and sender.
Import Pi Durable, pi-ai, pi-schema, and chord through src/agent/pi/ (durable.ts, shared.ts, …) so an upgrade is fixed in one folder.
Core imports no door or extension (COD-208, COD-210): only the composition root (agent-do.ts, composition.ts) names them. Reach a feature through a connector.
Core never depends on the web client or the Worker (COD-246): they depend on core and the protocol, not the other way round.

The web client reaches Pi Durable, pi-ai and chord only through the wire contract (src/protocol.ts, COD-246).

The web client imports only the wire contract (src/protocol.ts), src/lib/, npm packages and itself (COD-246), so an extension switched off or an agent rolled back never breaks it. Re-export what it needs through src/protocol.ts.
